item.title: Self-Hosted STOMP Protocol Servers: RabbitMQ vs ActiveMQ vs RabbitMQ-STOMP
item.description: The Simple (or Streaming) Text Oriented Messaging Protocol (STOMP) is a lightweight messaging protocol that defines a format and set of commands for interoperable message brokering. Unlike AMQP or MQTT, STOMP uses a simple text-based frame format similar to HTTP, making it easy to implement and debug across different programming languages and platforms.
